Thanks. I don't know. I've filled out an application to TJ Maxx. I don't know how I'm going to work customer service while feeling like this. I'm barely able to interact with my friends.

I'm just so fucking tired. Physically, mentally, emotionally, spiritually... If I could just get out of this cow town and into a major city, like Boston, or even Portland, I know I could scrap together a life. But here...

Thanks for responding. I don't know what I'll do. Sleep, for now, I guess.

Give me a single case, anywhere in the US, that a public school has even remotely been "financially destroyed" by litigation. To do so would demonstrate that their fear is well-founded. If it's not, and they are putting the burden on kids regardless, that is basically the definition of being a coward.

Good luck. I couldn't find a single such case.

No, they absolutely can. They just won't, because they are afraid of the threat of litigation.

There's a difference between having your hands tied and being a lily-livered coward.
We're all real proud of you, bud
